name: 01_precision_convergence
caption_en: Fixed E0 data convergence; initial failures retained. These finite discrete cases are not a uniform continuum certificate.
caption_zh: 固定 E0 数据精度对照，保留最初失败。有限离散案例不等于统一连续 PDE 认证。

name: 02_four_blocks_born
caption_en: Same-discretization Maxwell four-block identity versus target-Born error. Exact algebra uses paid port setup; it does not establish continuum accuracy or speedup.
caption_zh: 同一离散 Maxwell 算子的四块恒等式与目标 Born 误差。精确代数使用已计费端口准备，不证明连续精度或加速。

name: 03_confusion_models
caption_en: Full16RX local linear information: pose, intrinsic target, then gain and anchored navigation. Last model includes declared statistical priors; bare principal angles alone do not equal prior-assisted retention.
caption_zh: 完整 16 接收器的局部线性信息：位姿、目标内禀参数、增益和已锚定导航。最后一项包含声明的统计先验，裸主角不等于先验辅助保留率。

name: 04_aperture_retention
caption_en: Local retention depends on aperture and nuisance sharing. RX8 is a single-complex-port mechanism control; it does not demonstrate full-aperture finite ambiguity. Actual-motion and hypothetical equality panels retain their original labels.
caption_zh: 局部信息保留依赖孔径与干扰参数共享方式。RX8 为单复端口机制对照，不证明完整孔径的有限歧义；实际运动与假设相等约束沿用原标签。

name: 05_finite_corrector
caption_en: Paid finite correctors at RX8, compared with the fixed local prediction. Red crosses retain optimizer nonconvergence. Local and finite residuals are separate evidence; these profiles are not A0 inference or full-aperture ambiguity.
caption_zh: RX8 已计费有限补偿剖面与固定局部预测对照。红叉保留优化不收敛；局部与有限残差分开记录，不属于 A0 推断或完整孔径歧义。

name: 06_sampled_fields
caption_en: Actual saved E0 representative material and complex total field at quadrature points (initial derivative grid). Deterministic display subsampling only; this image is not an independent error check.
caption_zh: 实际保存的 E0 代表材料与复总场，取自最初导数网格的积分点。仅确定性抽样显示，该图不是独立误差审核。
